summary: Reads A1 notation into a grid range.
description: The result carries the sheet name when the notation had one and `null` when it did not, the range part on its own, and the four zero-based bounds the Sheets API works in.
Open notations are understood: `"A:A"` is a whole column and leaves the row bounds out, `"1:1"` a whole row.

params.a1Notation: The notation to read, with or without a sheet name.

examples.title: Reading A1 notation
